name: io.github.hmkim/centerfield-visitor-mcp
description: Centerfield building (Seoul) visitor pre-registration: validate, preview and register visitors.

environmentVariables.name: CF_ENV_FILE
environmentVariables.description: Absolute path to a .env holding CF_COMPANY_NAME and CF_PERSON_IN_CHARGE_MOBILE (optional if ~/.config/centerfield-visitor-mcp/.env exists)

environmentVariables.name: CF_COMPANY_NAME
environmentVariables.description: Tenant company name exactly as registered in Centerfield

environmentVariables.name: CF_PERSON_IN_CHARGE_MOBILE
environmentVariables.description: Mobile number of the approval contact registered in Centerfield

environmentVariables.name: CF_DEFAULT_FLOOR
environmentVariables.description: Floor used when a row omits it (12 or 18)
